english.note: Use this for an eventual outcome after everything has happened, often with a disappointed or ironic tone rather than for numbering items.

examples.english: He talked such a good game, but ultimately he still did not do it.
examples.traditional: 佢講到咁好聽，到頭來都係冇做到。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 dou3 gam3 hou2 teng1 dou3 tau4 loi4 dou1 hai6 mou5 zou6 dou3
